channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: Bharat Bandh Feb 12: From Banks to Buses, What May Be Affected? Full Details Here
item.description: Trade unions and farmers’ groups have called a Bharat Bandh on February 12 to protest labour reforms and trade policies, potentially disrupting banks, transport and public services across several states.

item.title: India to Lead G20 Economies with 6.4% GDP Growth in FY27, Backed by Strong Consumption and Stable Banks
item.description: Moody’s Ratings projects India to remain the fastest-growing G20 economy with 6.4 per cent GDP growth in FY2026-27, supported by strong domestic demand and a resilient banking sector.

item.title: Washington: Pilot Safely Lands Failing Plane on Busy Georgia Road, Collides With 3 Vehicles but Averts Tragedy
item.description: Pilot Safely Lands Failing Plane on Busy Georgia Road, Collides With 3 Vehicles but Averts Tragedy

item.title: Odisha Village Boycotts Anganwadi After Dalit Woman’s Appointment, Children’s Services Disrupted for 3 Months
item.description: Villagers in Kendrapara allegedly refused to send children after a Dalit woman was appointed helper, prompting administrative intervention to restore ICDS services.

item.title: Uttar Pradesh: Vrindavan Hotel Catches Fire Hours After Opening; 3 Injured, Dozens Rescued
item.description: A suspected transformer short circuit triggered the blaze at Siddhi Vinayak Hotel in Mathura’s Vrindavan area, prompting a large-scale rescue operation and raising fresh concerns over fire safety compliance.

item.title: Raghav Chadha Pushes for National Blockchain Property Register to Fix India’s Broken Land Records System
item.description: Rajya Sabha MP Raghav Chadha has proposed a nationwide blockchain-based registry to make India’s land records transparent, tamper-proof, and free from long-standing disputes.

item.title: 14.32s to Glory: India’s Preeti Pal Wins 100m Gold at Dubai World Para Athletics Grand Prix 2026
item.description: The Indian sprint star, Preeti Pal opened her 2026 season with a commanding 14.32-second finish at the Dubai World Para Athletics Grand Prix.

item.title: EPFO to Introduce UPI-Based Provident Fund Withdrawals Through New Mobile App
item.description: The Centre plans to launch a new EPFO mobile app by April enabling subscribers to withdraw up to 75 percent of their provident fund directly through UPI-linked bank accounts.

item.title: From Banana Waste to ₹1 Crore Enterprise Empowering 1,000 Farmers with Sustainable Rural Innovation
item.description: A visionary couple transformed discarded banana stems into a sustainable enterprise, creating new income for over 1,000 farmers while reducing agricultural waste.

item.title: Russia Blocks WhatsApp in Sweeping Digital Crackdown, Pushing Millions Towards State-Backed Messaging App
item.description: Russia has restricted WhatsApp nationwide, citing security concerns, as critics warn of privacy risks and digital isolation.
